description: Delete local git branches safely without tripping dcg: merged-PR cleanup (cleanup-local-branches) and my own non-PR branches (reviews, scratch, finished deps branches), each checked so no unpushed work is lost.

delete.description: Delete named local branches (or every branch with a --prefix) when nothing would be lost: never the default/current/worktree branch, and only when every commit is reachable from another ref or the branch's PR was merged. --dry-run reports, --force skips the commit check. Logs each SHA with a restore command.

args.name: branch
args.description: Branch names to delete (repeatable); or use --prefix

merged.description: Run cleanup-local-branches in a repo: deletes local branches whose PR merged, skips open/draft/closed-unmerged PRs (--yes deletes closed-unmerged too). Flags pass through (--dry-run, --yes, --no-pr, --open-pr, --archive, --merged).
